title: Fix MP3 uploads in the audio upload system

requirements.text: Update the audio file selection validation so that .mp3 files can be selected and accepted even when the browser reports an empty/unknown MIME type (e.g., file.type is ""), while still rejecting clearly non-audio files.

quotes: The upload system does not allow me to upload mp3 files. Debug the upload system

acceptanceCriteria: In MediaUploadDialog, selecting a valid .mp3 file is not blocked by the `file.type.startsWith('audio/')` check when `file.type` is empty/unknown.
Non-audio files (e.g., .txt) are still rejected with a clear error message.
The file input accept configuration explicitly includes MP3 support (e.g., includes .mp3 and/or audio/mpeg) and continues to allow other supported audio formats.

requirements.text: Make metadata extraction for uploads robust for MP3s: if Web Audio API `decodeAudioData` fails for an MP3, fall back to an alternate duration detection strategy (e.g., HTMLAudioElement metadata loading). If duration still cannot be determined automatically, allow the user to manually enter/edit the track duration in the upload UI and proceed with upload.

quotes: The upload system does not allow me to upload mp3 files. Debug the upload system

acceptanceCriteria: In MediaUploadDialog, MP3 files that fail `decodeAudioData` are still added to the upload queue instead of being dropped with only a generic “Failed to process” error.
Duration is populated via a fallback method when `decodeAudioData` fails, for common MP3 files.
If duration cannot be auto-detected, the UI allows manually editing duration (and the upload flow permits uploading with the entered duration).
Uploading an MP3 from MediaUploadDialog successfully completes and creates a track in the media library.

requirements.text: Verify and, if needed, adjust the backend/blob-storage integration so that storing and serving uploaded MP3 blobs works correctly (including correct handling of audio/mpeg content type where applicable) and does not reject MP3 uploads.

quotes: The upload system does not allow me to upload mp3 files. Debug the upload system

acceptanceCriteria: A successfully uploaded MP3 blob can be stored via the existing `addMediaTrack(..., url: Storage.ExternalBlob)` flow without backend traps or storage-layer rejections specific to MP3.
If the storage layer requires/uses content type, MP3 uploads are stored/served with an appropriate MP3 MIME type (audio/mpeg) so playback works in the frontend player.
Backend errors returned for upload failures remain actionable (no silent failures), and frontend receives a meaningful error message if an upload is rejected.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding support for new non-audio file types.
Implementing third-party storage providers or external databases.
Changing authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth option).
